name: ruff
command: py -3.11 -m ruff check src/ hub/ tests/ && py -3.11 -m ruff check scripts/ --select E9,F63,F7,F82,F401,F841

name: black
command: py -3.11 -m black --check --target-version py311 src/ hub/hub/ hub/tests/ tests/

name: hub-ui
command: cd hub/ui && (node -e "process.exit(require('fs').existsSync('node_modules')?0:1)" || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline) && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run
